The customer is stuck right now and needs a tow, so this is roadside_assistance. They also say a prior repair or test (battery "tested fine") failed, which hints at a repair we did causing it. The tie-break says to go to needs_human if the customer reports that a repair we did caused it or demands a manager. The battery was only tested, not repaired, and no manager was demanded. The car is dead in a parking lot, with no repair of ours causing the failure, only a missed diagnosis. I'll keep roadside_assistance with a safety escalation, and list warranty_claim and repair_status as secondary types.
